method: Direct view tool reads of one original PNG per SHA-256-identical group. All 49 originals retained; 26 distinct byte groups viewed at original dimensions, without montage/crop substitution.

observations.fontPanels: All 30 scoped Han visible across Gothic, Mincho, Textbook and Brush in three actual Compose panels. No blank/replacement boxes observed. Focused 冴/次/汗/河/牙 remain distinguishable; actual 冫 has two marks and 氵 three. 冱 and the whole words 冴える/冱える/冴寒 are readable. The three cmap-absent characters 冫/冱/氵 use readable fallback; the image does not identify a particular underlying fallback face.
observations.selectionMeaning: N1 selected, 112 cards. 冴 meaning question displays clear; sharp-minded as the key with permit; sincerity, broom; comet and peng; giant mythical bird as alternatives. Correct feedback and embedded article visible.
observations.curatedReading: One kun question offers さえる, with correct kun feedback and 1 of 1 session completion. Feedback retains the full source reading display; this is not evidence that excluded source readings were offered. Actual Full/Lite/key/log assertions are in the native route record.
observations.articlesAndRoutes: The captured states collectively expose both complete articles, their explanations/examples, source-only reading dispositions, comparison forms and source citations. Linked 冴える and reciprocal 冴 are visible. System Back states restore the word component section and kanji common-word section.
observations.tableViewport: The table explicitly says to scroll sideways. Left-aligned states expose all reading labels; horizontally shifted states expose complete explanatory cells. Some row labels or explanatory text are clipped in individual states, and some long English words wrap within a column. Combined captures and native selectors establish navigation to the content, not a single-frame all-columns claim or a general UI certification.
observations.drawing: Seven-stroke reference trace shown, followed by injected reference-stroke comparison and separate give-up recall feedback. Trace feedback says practice only and stroke shapes only, handwriting model not available. Reference outline and numbered correct-stroke diagram readable. This is not human freehand recognition or demonstrated recall.

limits: Coordinator inspection only; two serial original-family independent visual confirmations still required. Native emulator API35, not physical phone. 120 per-character and four whole-word Paint assertions/raster hashes are not 124 independently viewed PNGs, a fallback-face identification or linguistic certification. Synthetic source/HEAD and disposable seeded review schedule, full production import once; no owner progress used. Offline handwriting model unavailable: injected reference trace/shape-only comparison/give-up recall do not establish MLKit recognition, human memory, phone acceptance or learning effectiveness. Existing source/read-depth/review/process/denial/OOM and general-release limits remain.
